title: A general framework for nonlocal traffic flow models on networks
summary: We present a general computational framework for macroscopic nonlocal traffic flow models on networks with multiple commodities. The model combines scalar conservation laws on edges with nonlocal velocity functions and couples them via buffer-based junction dynamics. Routing is defined in general as a prescription for distributing drivers across outgoing road segments.
